description: Use this whenever a user names or selects one residency, visa or citizenship program. Returns a canonical summary plus every sourced record: requirements, minimum income or investment, stay rules, years to permanent residency and citizenship, fees, processing time, legal basis, sources and verification dates. Pass a program_id from search_programs, find_visas, get_country_profile or get_recent_changes, or a program name.

program.description: A program_id such as "panama-friendly-nations-visa", or part of a program name such as "Paraguay investor".

name: get_program
title: Get complete immigration program
